cards.audioText: When is external electrical power used on an aircraft?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-4
cards.audioTextZh: 航空器在什么时候使用外部电源？
cards.referenceText: External electrical power is used while the aircraft is on the ground, normally before the engines are started. It is particularly useful when the APU is unavailable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 外接电源在飞机位于地面时使用，通常在发动机起动前接通。APU 不可用时尤其有用。

cards.audioText: What can cause an aircraft electrical system to fail during flight?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-8
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器电气系统在飞行中失效？
cards.referenceText: An electrical failure may be caused by a generator or alternator failure, a short circuit, damaged wiring, overheating, or a battery malfunction. Lightning, an onboard fire, or improper maintenance can also lead to a failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电气故障可能由发电机或交流发电机失效、短路、线路损坏、过热或电池故障造成。雷击、机上火灾或维修不当也会导致故障。

cards.audioText: When might the APU be used to supply electrical power?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-5
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下可以使用 APU 供电？
cards.referenceText: On the ground, the APU may supply electrical power before the engines are started, especially when a ground power unit is unavailable. In flight, it may provide power after an engine failure if the APU is available for that operation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在地面，APU 可以在发动机起动前提供电力，尤其在地面电源车不可用时。飞行中，如果 APU 适用于该运行且实际可用，它可以在发动机失效后提供电力。

cards.audioText: How can an electrical system failure affect an aircraft and its operation?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-9
cards.audioTextZh: 电气系统失效会如何影响航空器及其运行？
cards.referenceText: An electrical failure can cause the loss of instrument displays, lighting, navigation, or communication equipment. It may disconnect the autopilot and increase the crew's workload. It can also be associated with smoke or an onboard fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电气故障会造成仪表显示、灯光、导航或通信设备丧失，可能使自动驾驶仪断开并增加机组工作负荷，还可能伴有烟雾或机上火灾。

cards.audioText: What sources of electrical power are available on your aircraft?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-3
cards.audioTextZh: 你的航空器有哪些电源？
cards.referenceText: The exact electrical system depends on the DA-40 variant. In general, the engine-driven alternator is the main source in flight, the aircraft battery provides power for starting and backup, and an external power source may be used on the ground. I confirm the installed sources and their limitations in the applicable aircraft flight manual.
cards.referenceTextZh: 具体电气系统取决于 DA-40 的具体型号。通常，发动机驱动的交流发电机是飞行中的主电源，飞机电池用于起动和备用，外接电源可以在地面使用。我会在适用的飞机飞行手册中确认已安装电源及其限制。

cards.audioText: What should a flight crew do if an electrical failure causes the loss of cockpit displays?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-10
cards.audioTextZh: 电气故障导致驾驶舱显示器失效时，飞行机组应怎么做？
cards.referenceText: The crew should use backup power and the standby instruments to maintain control and navigation. They can request radar vectors from ATC if that service is available. If necessary, they should declare urgency and divert to a suitable airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应使用备用电源和备用仪表保持控制和导航。如果空中交通管制能够提供雷达服务，可以申请雷达引导。必要时应宣布紧迫状态并改航至合适机场。

cards.audioText: What should a flight crew do if one source of electrical power fails during flight?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-2
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中一个电源失效时，飞行机组应怎么做？
cards.referenceText: The crew should follow the SOP and complete the applicable checklist. They should use the available backup power and switch off unnecessary electrical equipment to conserve it. They should advise ATC and arrange to land at a suitable airport if the failure cannot be resolved.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应遵循标准操作程序并完成适用检查单。他们应使用可用备用电源，并关闭非必要电气设备以节省电量。如果故障无法排除，应通知空中交通管制并安排在合适机场着陆。

cards.audioText: What are the main functions of an aircraft's electrical system?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-6
cards.audioTextZh: 航空器电气系统的主要功能有哪些？
cards.referenceText: The electrical system supplies power to essential aircraft systems and flight instruments. It supports lighting, navigation, communication, instrument displays, flight controls, air conditioning, passenger services, and emergency equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电气系统为飞机关键系统和飞行仪表供电，支持灯光、导航、通信、仪表显示、飞行操纵、空调、旅客服务和应急设备。

cards.audioText: What should a flight crew do if an electrical system failure occurs during flight?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-7
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中电气系统失效时，飞行机组应怎么做？
cards.referenceText: The crew should use any available standby instruments to maintain control and navigation. They should inform ATC, declare an emergency if necessary, and divert to a suitable airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应使用任何可用备用仪表保持控制和导航。他们应通知空中交通管制，在必要时宣布紧急状态，并改航至合适机场。

cards.audioText: Have you ever experienced an aircraft electrical system failure?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机系统-电力系统失效-1
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否曾遇到航空器电气系统失效？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never experienced an aircraft electrical system failure in flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我从未在飞行中遇到过飞机电气系统失效。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me something about the components of electric system in an aircraft?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与系统-26
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍下机上电气系统组件吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Aircraft are installed with either a 14 or 28 volt direct-current electrical system, and normally aircraft electric system consists of the following parts: generator, battery, battery switch, bus bar, fuses, and circuit breakers, voltage regulator, load meter, associated electrical wiring, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。飞机安装有14或28伏直流电气系统。通常飞机电气系统由以下部件组成：发电机、电池、电池开关、汇流条、保险丝、断路器、稳压器、测力计和关联电线等。

cards.audioText: What if the electrical system malfunctions?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与系统-28
cards.audioTextZh: 如果电气系统出现故障该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Electrical failure is not very common but does happen every now and then. Usually a blown fuse or circuit breaker popping indicating a temporarily overload on that device or circuit. If it's circuit breaker tripped, resolve it as the way that nonessential circuit breakers are not to be reset in flight, but essential circuit breakers are to be reset. If it's inverter inoperative, select the other inverter.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电气系统故障虽不常见但偶尔发生。通常，保险丝熔断或断路器弹出，代表该设备或电路临时超载。若断路器跳闸，不用重置副断路器，但要重置主断路器。若换流器失效，可以选择另一台换流器。

cards.audioText: What if the electrical system malfunctions in flight?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与系统-10
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中电气系统发生故障应如何应对？
cards.referenceText: First I will do some immediate action such as reset alternator/ generator by turning their switches or circuit breakers off, then on again. If problem persists, I will turn alternator/generator off, start conserve battery power and request priority landing at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先我会立即采取一些行动，如通过重启开关或关闭断路器来重置发电机。如果问题仍未解决，我会关闭发电机，节省电量，并请求优先降落在最近的机场。

cards.audioText: Where do airplanes get their electrical supply?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与系统-9
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在哪里充电？
cards.referenceText: Engines are the main devices that supply electrical power to the aircraft, besides, the ground power and APU can supply power to the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机是为飞机提供电能的主要装置，此外地面电源和APU（辅助动力装置）也可以为飞机提供电能。

cards.audioText: How does the electric system work in aircraft?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与系统-27
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机上的电气系统如何工作？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft electrical system is a self contained network of components that generate, transmit, distribute, utilize and store electrical energy. It can be turned on or off with a battery switch which controls the electrical power to aircraft in a way similar to the master switch. Turning the battery switch to "ON" position can provide electrical energy to all the electrical facilities circuits except the ignition system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机的电气系统是由产生、传输、分配、利用和存储电能的部件组成的封闭网络。它由一电池开关控制，以类似于主开关的方式掌控飞机的电力。将电池开关转到“ON”位置可以向除点火系统外的所有电气设备电路提供电能。

cards.audioText: What may cause electrical failure?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与飞机系统-27
cards.audioTextZh: 什么会导致电气系统故障？
cards.referenceText: Many factors may cause electrical failure, for example, lightning strike, electrical short circuit, engine failure, generator failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 导致电气故障的因素有很多，如雷击、电气短路、发动机故障、发电机故障等。

cards.audioText: What is the function of electrical systems?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与飞机系统-11
cards.audioTextZh: 电气系统的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: It is used to provide electrical power to the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 它被用来给飞机提供电力。

cards.audioText: If you encounter electrical failure during flight, what will you do?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与飞机系统-25
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行过程中遭遇电气失效，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter electrical failure during flight, the alternate electrical system will work automatically.
If both electrical systems fail, I can use APU or battery, to provide power to the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh:
如果我在飞行中遇到电气系统故障，备用电力系统将自动工作。
如果两个电气系统都出现故障，我可以使用APU或电池，为飞机提供电力。

cards.audioText: If you encounter display failure because of electrical power, what are you going to do?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与飞机系统-28
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你遇到因电气系统故障导致的显示故障，你该怎么办？
cards.referenceTextZh:
在这种情况下，首先我们会按照标准操作程序来做检查单；
其次我们将呼叫空中交通管制员，请求雷达引导；
如有必要，我们将尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: What kind of problems will be caused by electrical failure?
cards.taskTitle: 飞机与飞机系统-26
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机电气系统失效后，会造成什么问题？
cards.referenceText:
Electrical failure will affect other systems.
Such as display, lights and navigation system, and even endanger flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
电气故障会影响其他系统。
如显示器、灯光和导航系统等，甚至危及飞行安全。
